purpose: One whole-suite baseline attempt while CI wiring was implemented independently; not real Linux, isolation or final acceptance
command: coverage run --rcfile=config/eval-harness-coveragerc scripts/ci/run_eval_harness_coverage.py; coverage combine; coverage json; exact --check-summary guard

first_attempt.cause: Parent chose /tmp as TMPDIR ancestor, but /tmp is a macOS symlink. Existing canonical-path guards correctly reject this test configuration.
first_attempt.correction: Do not weaken production guards. Repeat once with an explicitly physical /private/tmp root.

observed_platform_limits: Cursor tests reach the existing published-Linux-x86_64-only preflight guard on macOS arm64.
Casefold-collision fixtures cannot create both A/a directory names on this case-insensitive filesystem; two fixture mkdir calls raise FileExistsError, while file overwrites erase intended collisions.
physical_path_attempt.unrun: The top-level shell suite exits after failing unittest, so any later shell stages are not claimed complete.

decision: No more local whole-suite repetitions or changes to already accepted platform guards/collision policies. Use the fixed Linux CI gate; expand meaningful PR04 worker/host regression coverage with the upcoming boundary implementation. Keep this failed local result explicit, not waived or accepted.
original_tmp_alias_issue: Resolved by the one physical-path correction; the remaining unsupported-platform fixtures are distinct, not a reset of the same issue's history.
